question: What is the primary cause for the highest precipitation in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South-West Monsoon**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **South-West Monsoon** is the primary cause for the highest precipitation in India.
 
• The South-West Monsoon winds bring abundant rainfall to most parts of India, particularly the western coast and northeastern regions.
